find_address_at_location.description: Turn a latitude and longitude into the nearest street address, with the places of interest and stops around it.
find_address_at_location.display_name: Find the address at a location
find_address_at_location.name: find_address_at_location

parameters.description: The latitude, for example 59.9133.
parameters.name: latitude

parameters.description: The longitude, for example 10.7389.
parameters.name: longitude

parameters.description: How far from the location to look, in metres. Default 200.
parameters.name: radius_meters

find_bike_stations.description: Find city bike docks near a place (Oslo, Bergen, Trondheim and more), nearest first, with how many bikes and free docks each has right now.
find_bike_stations.name: find_bike_stations

parameters.description: Where to search around: an address, a stop or a place name (for example Karl Johans gate 22, Oslo), or a latitude and longitude such as 59.9110, 10.7500.
parameters.name: location

parameters.description: How far from the location to look, in metres. Default 500.
parameters.name: radius_meters

parameters.description: The most stations to return. Default 10.
parameters.name: limit

find_lines.description: Find bus, train, tram, metro and ferry lines by number or name, or list every line a company runs, with who operates each one.
find_lines.name: find_lines

parameters.description: A line number such as 31 or R12, or part of a line's name such as Flybuss. Leave empty to list a company's lines.
parameters.name: search

parameters.description: The transport company, such as Ruter, Vy or Skyss.
parameters.name: company

parameters.description: Only lines of these modes. Leave empty for every mode.
parameters.name: transport_modes

parameters.description: The most lines to return. Default 50.
parameters.name: limit

find_nearby_stops.description: Find the stops within walking distance of an address, a place or a pair of coordinates, nearest first, with how far each one is.
find_nearby_stops.name: find_nearby_stops

parameters.description: Where to search around: an address, a stop or a place name (for example Karl Johans gate 22, Oslo), or a latitude and longitude such as 59.9110, 10.7500.
parameters.name: location

parameters.description: How far from the location to look, in metres. Default 500.
parameters.name: radius_meters

parameters.description: Only stops served by any of these. Leave empty for every stop.
parameters.name: transport_modes

parameters.description: The most stops to return. Default 10.
parameters.name: limit

find_rental_vehicles.description: Find e-scooters, bikes, mopeds and cars free to rent near a place, nearest first, with the operator, battery level and range.

vehicles.price_description: Pay as you go pricing plan with unlock fee and per minute pricing

find_rental_vehicles.name: find_rental_vehicles

parameters.description: Where to search around: an address, a stop or a place name (for example Karl Johans gate 22, Oslo), or a latitude and longitude such as 59.9110, 10.7500.
parameters.name: location

parameters.description: Only these kinds. Leave empty for every kind.
parameters.name: vehicle_kinds

parameters.description: How far from the location to look, in metres. Default 300.
parameters.name: radius_meters

parameters.description: The most vehicles to return. Default 20.
parameters.name: limit

find_stops.description: Find bus stops, stations, quays and airports in Norway by name, best match first, with the transport modes that serve each one and where it is.
find_stops.name: find_stops

parameters.description: All or part of the stop's name.
parameters.name: query

parameters.description: Only stops served by any of these. Leave empty for every stop.
parameters.name: transport_modes

parameters.description: The most stops to return. Default 10.
parameters.name: limit

get_departures.description: Get the next departures (or arrivals) at a stop with live times: line, destination, platform, how late it is running and whether it is cancelled, plus a ready-to-send summary line for each.

departures.summary: 20:13 Train L1 to Spikkestad, platform 7 (2 min late)

mock_response.summary: 20:13 Train L1 to Spikkestad, platform 7 (2 min late)

get_departures.name: get_departures

parameters.description: The stop or station, by name as it appears on the sign (for example Oslo S). A stop id from an earlier step works too.
parameters.name: stop

parameters.description: Departures leaving the stop, or arrivals reaching it.
parameters.name: show

parameters.description: List departures from this date and time (Norwegian time). Leave empty for right now.
parameters.name: start_time

parameters.description: Only departures in this many minutes after the start. Default 120.
parameters.name: within_minutes

parameters.description: The most departures to return. Default 10.
parameters.name: limit

parameters.description: Only departures by any of these. Leave empty for every mode.
parameters.name: transport_modes

parameters.description: Only departures on this line, by its number as shown on the vehicle (for example 31 or R12). Leave empty for every line.
parameters.name: line

parameters.description: Only departures from this platform or stand, for example 3 or A. Leave empty for every platform.
parameters.name: platform

parameters.description: List cancelled departures too, marked as cancelled, so a workflow can warn about them.
parameters.name: include_cancelled

get_line_details.description: Get one line in full: who runs it, its colour, every stop on its longest route in order, its route variants, and disruptions reported for the whole line.
get_line_details.name: get_line_details

parameters.description: The company that runs the line, to list its lines.
parameters.name: company

parameters.description: The line. Pick a company to list its lines, or type a line id from an earlier step.
parameters.name: line

get_live_vehicles.description: See where the buses, trams, trains or boats on a line are right now: position, next stop, delay and how full they are. Not every company shares vehicle positions.
get_live_vehicles.name: get_live_vehicles

parameters.description: The company that runs the line, to list its lines.
parameters.name: company

parameters.description: The line. Pick a company to list its lines, or type a line id from an earlier step.
parameters.name: line

get_service_disruptions.description: Get the service messages operators have published: cancellations, delays, closed stops and diversions, with what they affect and how long they last. Narrow them to a company, a line, a stop or a transport mode.

disruptions.description: The train has been cancelled between Roa and Gjøvik. This is due to work on the track.

get_service_disruptions.name: get_service_disruptions

parameters.description: The transport company, such as Ruter, Vy or Skyss.
parameters.name: company

parameters.description: Only disruptions affecting this line. Pick a company to list its lines, or type a line number. Leave empty for every line.
parameters.name: line

parameters.description: Only disruptions affecting this stop, by name. Leave empty for every stop.
parameters.name: stop

parameters.description: Only disruptions affecting lines of any of these modes. Leave empty for every mode.
parameters.name: transport_modes

parameters.description: Leave out messages milder than this.
parameters.name: minimum_severity

parameters.description: Leave out announced disruptions that have not started yet or have ended.
parameters.name: in_effect_now

parameters.description: The language of the messages. When a message has no text in it, the other language is used.
parameters.name: language

parameters.description: The most disruptions to return. Default 50.
parameters.name: limit

get_stop_details.description: Get a stop's platforms, the lines that call there, its fare zones, step-free access per platform, and any disruptions reported for it.
get_stop_details.name: get_stop_details

parameters.description: The stop or station, by name as it appears on the sign (for example Oslo S). A stop id from an earlier step works too.
parameters.name: stop

plan_trip.description: Plan a journey on public transport between two places in Norway, leaving after or arriving by a time. Each suggestion lists its legs (walks and rides, with line, platform and live delays) and a one-line summary.

legs.summary: 20:22–20:48 Metro 1 towards Frognerseteren from Jernbanetorget (platform 2) to Holmenkollen

plan_trip.name: plan_trip

parameters.description: Where the trip starts: a stop, an address or a place (for example Oslo S or Karl Johans gate 22, Oslo), or a latitude and longitude.
parameters.name: from_location

parameters.description: Where the trip ends, in any of the same forms.
parameters.name: to_location

parameters.description: When to leave (or arrive, with Arrive by). Norwegian time. Leave empty for now.
parameters.name: date_time

parameters.description: Plan backwards so you arrive by the date and time, instead of leaving after it.
parameters.name: arrive_by

parameters.description: Only travel by these. Leave empty to use any public transport.
parameters.name: transport_modes

parameters.description: How many trip suggestions to return. Default 3.
parameters.name: number_of_trips

parameters.description: Only suggest trips with step-free access throughout.
parameters.name: wheelchair_accessible

search_places.description: Look up a Norwegian address, stop or landmark by name and get its full address and coordinates, best match first.
search_places.display_name: Look up an address or place
search_places.name: search_places

parameters.description: An address, a stop or a place name. Add the town to narrow it down, for example Karl Johans gate 22, Oslo.
parameters.name: query

parameters.description: The most places to return. Default 5.
parameters.name: limit

track_departure.description: Follow one departure from Get departures or Plan a trip: every stop it calls at with live times, which stops it has passed, the next stop and how late it is running.

mock_response.summary: Train L1 to Spikkestad: next stop Oslo S at 20:13, 2 min late.

track_departure.name: track_departure

parameters.description: The departure's service_journey_id, taken from Get departures or Plan a trip.
parameters.name: service_journey_id

parameters.description: The day the departure runs (its service_date). Leave empty for today.
parameters.name: service_date

description: Plan journeys and follow Norway's public transport live through Entur, the national registry of every operator's routes and real-time data: find stops, read live departure boards, plan trips from A to B, track a departure, check service disruptions, look up lines and vehicle positions, and find city bikes and rental scooters nearby. No account or API key is required.
